_comment: Tokens whose USD price the API fetches and caches.
tokenIDs are NOT listed here: they are derived from the bridge settings.
The symbol (or an alias) is matched against the ecosystem token names
served by the cardano api, and every wrapped representation of that asset
- anything the direction config bridges it to - inherits the price.
So APEX also covers cAP3X/bAP3X/bnAP3X, and ADA also covers xADA.
To track a new asset, add an entry with its ecosystem name and provider ids.
